title: Record of Decision - Cameco Corporation - Request to protect confidential information
text:
Record of Decision
Commission Ruling on
Request to Protect Confidential Information
Requestor: Cameco Corporation
Matter: CMD 23-H107—Cameco's Port Hope Conversion Facility - Financial
Guarantee
Date of proceeding: Written Hearing, to be held in December 2023
With respect to the matter noted above, the Commission has considered Cameco Corporation’s
request for confidentiality for the following documents for the December 2023 Commission hearing
in writing. This request was made pursuant to rule 12 of the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission
Rules of Procedure (the Rules).
The Commission’s ruling on this request is that, for the purposes of this proceeding:
RULING
DOCUMENT TITLE INFORMATION WILL MEASURE(S) TO BE TAKEN
BE PROTECTED
YES NO
1. Port Hope Conversion Facility ✓ ☐ Only the non-confidential (redacted) version or
Preliminary Decommissioning Plan 2022 summary shall be disclosed (see note, if
applicable).
Where the Commission has ruled in favour of confidentiality, the Commission is satisfied that
▪ as per subrule 12(1) (b) of the Rules, the information is confidential information of a financial,
commercial, scientific, technical, personal or other nature that is treated consistently as
confidential and the person affected has not consented to the disclosure;
▪ as per 12(2)(a) and 12(2)(b) of the Rules, protection of the information outweighs in
importance the public interest in public hearings and disclosure of evidence, and the measures
are designed so as not to affect the public nature of the proceeding except to the extent
necessary to adequately protect the information; and
▪ as per subrule 12(3) (b) of the Rules, the publication of information given to the Commission
or designated officer be restricted or prohibited.
